close_reason: Added JmapBackend::account_exists(). handle_mdn_send now returns accountNotFound for unknown accountId. Test mdn_send_unknown_account_returns_account_not_found added. Follow-up JMAP-mz5k tracks applying same fix to all other handlers.
description: handle_mdn_send Step 2 fetches identities via get_objects::<Identity>. If the accountId does not exist, get_objects returns an empty list (indistinguishable from an existing account with no identities). The handler returns Err(JmapError::invalid_arguments("identityId not found")) in both cases. RFC 8620 §3.6.2 requires accountNotFound as the method-level error when the accountId is unknown. A client that passes a valid identity under a wrong account will receive the wrong error type. The code comment acknowledges this (line 133-135) but says 'per the spec for MDN/send' without a spec citation — draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17 does not override RFC 8620 §3.6.2 on this point. Fix: add account_exists() or similar to MailBackend, or document this as an accepted design limitation shared by all handlers.
notes: Deferred: this is a systemic design gap (all handlers have same pattern). Fix requires adding account_exists() to MailBackend or accepting the inconsistency as a documented design choice. Needs human decision before acting.
title: MDN/send returns invalidArguments for unknown accountId (should be accountNotFound)
